posts.title: Canvas patch: we need testers!
posts.description: by Tushar 2026 June 29 emacs canvas The Canvas patch is almost done. Except that we need more testing, specifically for its MS Windows port. (Though testers on other operating systems like GNU/Linux and MacOS are also welcome.) Since we don't have any computers running MS Windows, we are not sure if the code is actually correct. Please follow the following instructions for testing it on MS Windows
